name: threadify-workflows
description: Source-backed creator plans and reviewable drafts, with optional Threadify services and approval-gated scheduling.

interface.longDescription: Set up a source Vault, create a day of posts, or plan seven days or four weeks. Draft locally from confirmed sources without a Threadify account. Connect Threadify for entitled Brain-informed drafting, saved drafts and scheduling after exact approval. Advanced skills preserve buyer research, X artifacts, Brain Sync, YouTube editing and approved-copy scheduling. Public methods and local review controls are MIT licensed; hosted Brain services and the shared corpus are not bundled. No automatic publishing or growth guarantees.
